messages:
marta_velaris: hi team — Velaris here. We want to onboard a custom summarization model for patient triage notes. Needs to run in Private (VPC) with HSM keywrap, PHI-safe configs, and low cost. can you confirm next steps?

emma_cs: thanks Marta. quick qs: model size/format? expected qps and latency SLOs? renewal timeline (we're up for renewal in 2 months) — want to flag risk if intake delayed.

marta_velaris: model is a finetuned 7B LLAMA-variant in fp16 + int8 quant artifacts, repo + weights ready. QPS ~8 req/s peak, avg 1–2. 95th p50 target ~300ms, p95 <750ms preferred. Renewal renews on 2024-12-15.

raj_se: @emma_cs — for 7B on private, we can hit those numbers on a Dedicated pool or small private cluster with batching off during low-latency paths. p50 300ms is doable with 1xA10s or 1xH100 with optimized kernels, but PHI + HSM favors Private with dedicated nodes.

emma_cs: noted. Marta — can we get sample eval set (100 anonymized cases) and a privacy attestation for the PHI handling? also capture any compliance reqs (PCI/PHI/GDPR) in the intake form.

marta_velaris: yes, sending sample eval in a sec. we can provide a signed attestation PDF. compliance: HIPAA, SOC2 required, also need customer-managed KMS (HSM) for key wrapping.

olivia_eng: looping in ops notes: we should run safety checks and hallucination/regression evals before rollout. proposing evaluation plan: 1) accuracy (ROUGE/QA F1) on heldout test, 2) safety classifiers on 1k prompts, 3) adversarial prompt set (50 prompts) to test PHI leakage.

omitya: (typo) — ignore

safety_ops_bot: [checklist created] Model Safety Intake: basic PII scan, red-team pass required, toxic content filter. Link: https://redwood.internal/safety/intakes/3311223344

olivia_eng: small sample eval config for CI: 
```
model: velaris-7b-finetune
quant: int8
deploy_mode: private-vpc
qps_target: 8
latency_slo_p95_ms: 750
eval_sets: /evals/velaris/triage_100.jsonl
run_safety_checks: true
```

emma_cs: perfect. I'll open a ticket for Dedicated vs Private cost comparison and risk to renewal. Marta — can you confirm whether logs can be redacted and whether token-level logging is allowed? need that for contract.

marta_velaris: logs must be redacted at token level. we will not allow raw text storage outside encrypted buckets.

raj_se: for rollout plan: stage 1 = canary on low-traffic private nodes (1% traffic) -> evaluate latency & quality -> stage 2 = ramp to 25% with auto-fallback to hosted smaller model if issues -> full production. will include automatic rollback on quality regression.

emma_cs: I'll schedule an enablement call with Velaris next week for runbook + how to use console dashboards. also collecting feedback points for the CSM renewal briefing.

marta_velaris: thx — please include SLA expectations in the enablement call.

safety_ops_bot: assigned: @olivia_eng and @safety_team. milestone: red-team pass in 7 business days.

deploy-bot: created deployment epic: https://redwood.internal/epics/VEL-3311223344 (CI checks queued) :rocket:

olivia_eng: one last ask — include a tiny prompt set for monitoring (20 prompts) to attach to the quality alerting on Redwood Console. we can template alerts for drift and drop in ROUGE/F1.

emma_cs: will capture that in the onboarding checklist and share the calendar invite. tagging renewal risk as medium-high until red-team complete. :warning:

marta_velaris: appreciated. sending artifacts now — will follow up on attestation doc. thanks everyone! :pray:
